posts.title: The expectation of effort ⇾
posts.description: I get where Manu is coming from… And, look, this is probably on me, because I still naively believe in human connections and some semblance of decency and kindness. Over the time I’ve known him, this is the thing that resonates from every conversation we have. It’s not worth putting in the effort if the people on the other side will not do even the bare minimum. And that’s a sad thought to have. T

posts.title: Without Reset Week 2
posts.description: Week 2 summary: No more YouTube on my phone, at all = Success No beverages other than water or coffee = Success Book reading before sleep as the only option = Success Continued 16:8 intermittent fasting daily = Success Feeling great. Next week is Thanksgiving week with some time away from normal routines and travel. Let’s see how I do!

posts.title: Fasting App Gold
posts.description: I’ve tried several fasting apps over the years. They all leave me with a feeling that they get the job done, but either have features I don’t want or are missing features that would make my fasting routine more enjoyable. I’m surprised that fasting tracking isn’t built into the Apple Health app. With cycle tracking there and the ability to log fasts to your Apple Health data in many fasting apps,
